scope: Scratch Home-mobile static-replacement SSR-markup trial retaining existing createRoot, not production integration. Isolated loopback cloned production build, gzip-negotiated HTML/JS/CSS/JSON/SVG, anonymous allowlisted reads to local API only; HTTPS requests blocked, no account or writes/provider sends. Lighthouse default simulated mobile and desktop presets; measurements must run without competing browser/build/coverage load. Compression models a required hosting delivery setting, not evidence that it is deployed. Lab LCP/CLS/TBT and accessibility only; TBT is not INP and these runs do not certify field p75 INP/LCP, representative 3D hardware or hosted latency. Raw reports in ignored artifacts/performance.
